Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, Maya Tech is an ideal use case for our Dedicated offering and we want to make it simple to close. To get to the revised pricing we proposed on the call, your team had mentioned being able to approve a short customer spotlight and allow us to display the Maya Tech logo on our customer page.

Quick summary of the ask (what we need from Maya Tech):
- Permission to use Maya Tech logo on redwood.com/customers (static image, no pricing)
- One short (1–2 paragraph) customer quote we can approve before publish
- Optional: a 30-minute joint webinar or case study interview within 90 days

In exchange we are offering the following concession to close the deal this quarter: 20% one-year subscription credit on the first-year committed Dedicated capacity (applies to base subscription only, not add-ons).

If you’re comfortable, please reply with any limits or brand guidelines and attach files for the logo and any usage restrictions. I’ve CC’d Marcus to ensure procurement and contract can align. I attached a quick SOW stub and an internal summary for our team.

Best,
Olga Petrov

Thanks for the clear summary. We’re open to a customer spotlight and logo placement with a few constraints:
